description: Steve Mould's channel features hands-on physics demonstrations and experiments that explore the hidden science behind everyday phenomena and curious objects. He frequently investigates fluid dynamics, material properties, and mechanical analogies, often using slow-motion footage or custom setups to reveal surprising effects like the "chain fountain" or the behavior of non-Newtonian fluids. The videos blend rigorous scientific explanation with a sense of playful curiosity, often focusing on counterintuitive results that challenge casual observation.
